Class OffscreenWindows.Window

java.lang.Object

Enclosing class:

Exact native-window handle returned only after successful creation.

    • guiScale

      public void guiScale(int scale)
      Keeps fonts and GUI coordinates at a fixed integer drawable-pixel scale during resize. Call on the client thread. One gives native-size bitmap text; two doubles each pixel. Zero restores Minecraft's scaling preference. Existing window ownership is unchanged.
      Parameters:
      scale - zero through sixteen

    • close

      public void close()
      Releases this window's session and requests its visual exit. The open property continues to describe native existence during that exit. Repeated calls are harmless.

    • closeImmediately

      public void closeImmediately()
      Releases this exact owner immediately, skipping its visual exit for teardown or failed setup.
